verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a line of offline USB/NFC hardware security keys (FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP, PIV) with a local CLI (nitropy). It is not a hosted service that emits events, so subscribing to events via outbound webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
